items.title: 2011 Family and Community Services General Obligation Bond Schedule (Initial Version)
items.description: Records the initial $32.85 million 2011 bond schedule for Family and Community Services, including facility repairs, Los Duranes, Westgate, Holiday Park, health and social-service centers, community centers, and vehicles.
items.provenance_status: official City 2011 GO Bond document-library record and direct file reviewed
processing_notes: Retained as the initial $32.85 million schedule, substantively distinct from the later validated $32.15 million Family and Community Services schedule.
Original official PDF preserved without modification; its direct City source was reviewed.
